headline: Starbucks China Mandates Purchases for Seating Across 8,000 Stores
summary: Starbucks has eliminated free seating across its 8,000 stores in China, requiring a purchase as the coffee chain invests 300 million yuan in staffing and store upgrades.
why: Starbucks faces fierce competition and pricing pressure from domestic Chinese coffee chains such as Luckin Coffee.

impacts.name: Starbucks Corporation
impacts.why: Mandating orders may improve table turnover and average spend, but risks alienating foot traffic.
